title: Missing Inactive Account Check in Vulnerable Auth Middleware
description: The vulnerable authentication middleware (vulnerableAuth.ts) does not validate whether the user account is active (UserStatus.ACTIVE) after verifying the JWT token. An inactive or banned user (UserStatus.INACTIVE) can still authenticate and access the system as long as their JWT token is valid and not expired. The secure implementation (api-secure) checks user.status === UserStatus.ACTIVE in the LoginCommand and RefreshTokenCommand.
impact: Banned, suspended, or deactivated users can continue to access the system until their access token naturally expires (up to 15 minutes). This allows banned users to retain access, undermining account suspension/deactivation as a security control.
mitigation: 1) Add account status validation in authentication middleware or in the login/refresh command handlers. 2) Check user.status === UserStatus.ACTIVE before allowing authentication. 3. Secure API (api-secure) implements this check in LoginCommand and RefreshTokenCommand via UserStatus.ACTIVE verification.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for missing inactive account check
